title: good concept poor pickup
text: good concept poor pickup. This is a very cutely made machine. The problem it is for very small jobs. 1/2 carpet and the bin needed emptying. Poor pickup bad suction. Is there a decent vacuum out there that can pick up the damn dog hair and sweep the carpet that will not break in 6 months and does not cost and arm and a leg? I am sick of trying.

product_metadata.title: Dirt Devil Dash Dual Cyclonic Bagless Upright Vacuum with Bonus Vac+Dust Floor Tool, UD70250B - Corded,Red
features: Direct Path Cleaning Technology captures dirt from edge to edge with an even band of suction across the entire cleaning path
SWIPES washable microfiber pad with DirtLock Technology traps and lifts dirt and dust, capturing what disposable pads can leave behind
Dual Cyclonic Filtration cuts through any mess with constant powerful suction
On-Demand Cleaning Wand instantly switches to above-floor cleaning to put the whole-room within reach
12' Extended Reach lets you stretch from floors to ceilings and catch everything in between
description: Strong and powerful meets quick and convenient. We built a full size vac with constant powerful suction to cut through whatever hits your floors. Then we gave it a little added kick — a Vac+Dust Hard Floor Tool that picks up heavy dirt and debris with a SWIPES microfiber pad that captures the dust. From couches to ceilings, carpet to hard floors, we’ve got you covered.
